text:
sara: Quick follow-up from yesterday's outage — sounds like three recurring vendor/dependency vectors: cloud infra throttling, model-registry timeouts, and our external auth provider hiccups. We need clear owners + timelines for mitigations.

mike: I can take the cloud infra side. Proposed mitigations: add multi-region failover for control-plane calls and tighten request throttling backoff. ETA 10 business days. @oncall-team please flag any constraints. :thumbsup:

anya: I'll own model-registry fixes. Plan: increase client-side retries with jitter, add local cache for model manifests (TTL 5m), and add health-check endpoint to detect degraded registry before routing. ETA 7 business days.

luis: For auth provider, my proposal is: implement circuit-breaker + cached short-lived tokens fallback (30s grace), and an alert that fires at 5% auth error rate over 5m. I'll also schedule an SRE runbook update. ETA 5 business days.

katie: I'll track these in the postmortem follow-up board and add a recurrent incident pattern card linking last 3 outages. Will create recurring audit task to review vendor incidents monthly.

incidents-bot: Created ticket INC-4872 (cloud-failover), INC-4873 (model-registry-caching), INC-4874 (auth-circuit-breaker). Assignees: mike, anya, luis.

sara: Nice. Couple notes: 1) For model-registry caching, ensure cache invalidation on rollout — don't block canaries. 2) For cloud failover, confirm latency SLA impact in canary region before enabling failover.

mike: noted. I'll add a perf run in staging and post numeric targets to the ticket.

anya: For cache invalidation we'll add a watch on model-version metadata and a short TTL fallback. I'll post the pseudo-code:

```
fetchManifest(id) {
  if (localCache.has(id) && !stale(localCache.get(id))) return localCache.get(id);
  let m = remote.fetch(id).retry({retries:3, jitter:true});
  localCache.set(id, m, ttl=300);
  return m;
}
```

luis: Circuit-breaker config: open after 10 failures or 3% err rate, half-open after 30s. Will push a flag to toggle in prod.

sara: Can everyone add a brief test plan to their ticket and mark "ready for review" when done? I'll review on Friday sync. Also we should add a postmortem follow-up check in two weeks to verify mitigations reduced recurrence.

mike: Test plan: failover smoke test + latency histogram, will attach results.

anya: Test plan: unit tests for retry/jitter, integration test simulating registry timeouts, and a canary with 10% traffic.

luis: Test plan: breaker simulation + auth-rate experiments, and a rollout to 20% with rollback hook.

katie: I'll create the two-week check event and add recurring monthly review.

sara: Thanks — please put actual dates in tickets. I'll escalate any resource blockers to Eng PM. :pray:

mike: putting dates now — aiming 2026-04-05 for cloud mitigation rollout.

anya: targeting 2026-03-31 for model-registry changes.

luis: targeting 2026-03-29 for auth circuit-breaker merge.

katie: Follow-up check scheduled 2026-04-12; monthly recurrence created.

sara: Great. One last item: can we add a short metric dashboard (vendor_errors, registry_latency, auth_fail_rate) to the incident runbook so oncall can spot regressions quickly?

mike: will add vendor_errors + regional latency panels.

anya: adding registry_latency and manifest-fetch p50/p95.

luis: adding auth_fail_rate + token-latency.

sara: Perfect. Marking this thread resolved for tracking — keep updates in the INC tickets. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
